title: Existing patient asks to reschedule and is handed off to reception
description: Caller already has a visit and wants to move it. The assistant should collect identity details, create a reception task, and avoid claiming success before tool confirmation.

script.speaker: caller
script.text: Dzien dobry, chcialbym przelozyc istniejaca wizyte. Wojciech Czub, numer siedem dziewiec trzy, trzy osiem piec, piec trzy jeden.

script.speaker: listen
script.text: Assistant reuses the provided identity data instead of asking for it again.

script.speaker: listen
script.text: Assistant confirms that the request was saved only after createReceptionTask returns success.

expected_evaluation.summary: Existing-patient reschedule requests should be routed to reception after identity capture and confirmed task creation.
expected_evaluation.recommended_next_action: Treat as a valid handoff path, not a booking failure.
